author: Fathom I
title: Baseline: ComBat on PCA
abstract: A baseline experiment conducted to meet publication requirements. This method applies the standard `scanpy.pp.combat` function to a PCA embedding of the data. The resulting corrected embedding is returned. This submission will serve as the primary point of comparison for the dual-output DAQB method in a forthcoming research paper.

original_submission.content:
import anndata as ad
import scanpy as sc
import numpy as np

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    print("Running Baseline: ComBat on PCA...")
    
    # Config
    n_pcs = 50

    # Preprocessing
    print("  Preprocessing data...")
    sc.pp.normalize_total(adata, target_sum=1e4)
    sc.pp.log1p(adata)
    sc.pp.highly_variable_genes(adata, flavor='seurat_v3', batch_key='batch', n_top_genes=2000, inplace=True)
    
    adata_hvg = adata[:, adata.var['highly_variable']].copy()

    # Generate PCA embedding
    print(f"  Computing PCA with {n_pcs} components...")
    sc.pp.pca(adata_hvg, n_comps=n_pcs, svd_solver='arpack', random_state=0)
    
    # Apply ComBat
    print("  Applying ComBat correction...")
    sc.pp.combat(adata_hvg, key='batch', use_highly_variable=False)
    
    # Create final output
    output = ad.AnnData(
        obs=adata.obs[[]],
        var=adata.var[[]],
        obsm={'X_emb': adata_hvg.obsm['X_pca'].astype(np.float32)}
    )
    
    print("✓ Baseline: ComBat on PCA complete.")
    return output
